verse.verse_1: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
verse.verse_2: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
verse.verse_3: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
verse.verse_4: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
verse.verse_5: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
verse.verse_6: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
verse.verse_7: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
verse.verse_8: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
verse.verse_9: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
verse.verse_10: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
verse.verse_11: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
verse.verse_12: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
verse.verse_13: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
verse.verse_14: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
verse.verse_15: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
verse.verse_16: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
verse.verse_17: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
verse.verse_18: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
verse.verse_19: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
verse.verse_20: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
verse.verse_21: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
verse.verse_22: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
verse.verse_23: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
verse.verse_24: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
verse.verse_25: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
verse.verse_26: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
verse.verse_27: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
verse.verse_28: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
verse.verse_29: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
verse.verse_30: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
verse.verse_31: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
verse.verse_32: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
verse.verse_33: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
verse.verse_34: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
verse.verse_35: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
verse.verse_36: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
verse.verse_37: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
verse.verse_38: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
verse.verse_39: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
verse.verse_40: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
verse.verse_41: Or have they some "Partners" (in Allahhead)? Then let them produce their "partners", if they are truthful!
verse.verse_42: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
verse.verse_43: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
verse.verse_44: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
verse.verse_45: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
verse.verse_46: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
verse.verse_47: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
verse.verse_48: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
verse.verse_49: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
verse.verse_50: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
verse.verse_51: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
verse.verse_52: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
